references.finding: triggers deploy passes resolved config and firstDeploy=false to triggersDeploy.
resolveTriggersInput resolves script name, routes and Cron input; resolveCronTriggers at line 191437 takes args.triggers or config.triggers.crons.
triggersDeploy unconditionally awaits subdomainDeploy before applying Cron schedules.

subdomainDeploy reads the Worker subdomain, then unconditionally POSTs /accounts/{account}/workers/scripts/{script}/subdomain with enabled and previews_enabled, including when desired settings match the existing values. The POST is wrapped by retryOnAPIFailure.
If crons is defined, including an empty array, the command PUTs /accounts/{account}/workers/scripts/{script}/schedules with crons.map(cron => ({cron})); an empty array removes all schedules.

boundedConclusion.schedulesOnlyAlternative: Explicit account/script PUT /workers/scripts/{script}/schedules with JSON [], followed by a schedules GET readback. This skips the subdomain mutation and unrelated trigger resources.
